messages:
rachel: Quick decision chat: sidecar-finalizer (per-region, low-latency) vs centralized-finalizer (one authoritative stream). need pros/cons and rollout path.
tom: my +1 for centralized for correctness and simpler auditing. single source of truth reduces reconciliation complexity.
mina: centralized adds cross-region latency and operational blast radius. sidecars are faster and simpler to scale per-region.
rachel: idea: hybrid: sidecar does micro-finalize for cold fingerprints (<X qps) and central does convergent merges for hot fingerprints. sidecars forward provenance to central for auditing.
tom: how to ensure deterministic convergence across sidecar+central hybrid? commit keys and finalizer_version must be consistent. example commit_key: "{tenant}|{fingerprint}|{window_start}|{finalizer_v}". central rejects duplicates.
mina: storage plan: raw provisional blobs -> cold S3 (90d). hot provenance envelopes (input_ids, blob_hashes, source_region) -> audit-db TTL 30d. audits link to S3 hashes.
ops-bot: NOTE: replay-quarantine & rate limits enforced for large reprocesses.
rachel: reprocess story: deterministic re-run over raw blobs to produce replacement canonical ranges + tombstone manifest. manifest includes checksums so consumers can validate and apply patches.
tom: emitter idempotency? use idempotent producer + WAL marker. write WAL before emitting canonical event; include seq and commit_key.
mina: API UX: keep showing provisional immediately with provenance_id. finalize later; adjustments as delta events with audit_links. console shows provisional vs finalized.
rachel: metrics and alerts: pending_finalizations, avg_finalize_latency, provisional_vs_final_delta_pct. alert if delta_pct > 1% or reprocess backlog grows.
tom: rollout: 1) feature-flag sidecars in staging (shadow) 2w; 2) central finalizer in shadow reading sidecar outputs 2w; 3) internal canary analytics 1w; 4) billing parallel-run 48h then cutover 1w. owners: routing (tom), audit-store (mina), finalizer (rachel).
mina: one more: adaptive window per fingerprint: cold -> 30s, hot -> 5m. reduces user surprise for small tenants.
rachel: ok I'll capture this in a short RFC + state diagram and open infra tickets tomorrow. ops-bot: TODO created: finalizer-hybrid-shadow schedule.
tom: +1
mina: +1
